definitions.descriptive_statistics_scope: Train only, except explicitly labeled test schema, row count, IDs, and Year_Factor support inventory.
definitions.missing: pandas.read_csv defaults; count per column and total.
definitions.constant: At most one distinct train value, counting missing as a distinct value.
definitions.nearconstant: Nonconstant train column whose most frequent value (including missing) occurs in at least 99% of train rows.
definitions.skewness: pandas.Series.skew(): unbiased sample skewness on numeric train values, excluding missing; null if undefined.
definitions.correlations: Pairwise complete observed numeric train feature values; exclude id and target; emit unique pairs with absolute coefficient >= 0.95. Pearson and Spearman separately.
definitions.dtype: pandas inferred dtype from unmodified CSV; not the data dictionary declared dtype.
definitions.raw_integrity: Every ZIP SHA256, CRC, member byte length, and member SHA256 checked against intake manifest before writing; path traversal and symlink checks passed; existing differing outputs are refused.

exact_feature_duplicates.definition: Exact equality of all original feature values excluding id and target, no rounding; pandas MultiIndex factorization over combined train/test feature tuples. This is structural inventory only.

numeric_linear_dependencies.scope: Purely diagnostic full TRAIN features, excludes id and target; no estimator fitted and no split/experiment score computed.
numeric_linear_dependencies.method: Median impute each numeric column on full TRAIN for inventory only, center and scale by population standard deviation; rank from SVD using max(shape)*eps*largest singular value. VIF diagnostics use diag(pinv(correlation, rcond=1e-12)); for nonzero exact nullspace loading classical VIF is infinite and pseudoinverse diagonal must not be interpreted as classical VIF.

pearson_threshold_095_pruning.rule: Traverse original CSV numeric column order; drop a column if absolute Pearson correlation on median-imputed TRAIN with any already kept column is >=0.95. No target or test used. This deterministic diagnostic is not a validated preprocessing recommendation.
